app.name: ScummVM (input/FMV test RPX)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.short_description: Pro Controller keyboard and Groovie FMV candidate
app.long_description: Native keyboard controller selection, late GamePad input and HOME cancellation; Groovie opaque-row rendering optimization and timing/audio-queue diagnostics. Retains previous fixes and Ogg/MP3/MT-32. Hardware confirmation is required; non-Aroma RPX unverified. Back up saves/config and read TESTING.md. No games or ROMs included.
